candidates.name: QuantaAlpha - alpha mining as evolved-and-validated trajectory reuse
candidates.improves_agent: WOLF (signal/factor generation) first, then Hartley Capital model-build
candidates.what: arXiv 2602.07085 (open code github.com/QuantaAlpha). Evolutionary LLM alpha-mining: each mining run is a trajectory improved via mutation/crossover; localizes the suboptimal step for targeted revision; recombines complementary high-reward segments to reuse validated experience; enforces hypothesis->factor-expression->executable-code semantic consistency; constrains complexity/redundancy to mitigate crowding. CSI300 (GPT-5.2): IC 0.1501, ARR 27.75%, MDD 7.98%; transfers to CSI500/S&P500 (160%/137% cumulative excess, 4y).
candidates.why: Constructive complement to the 06-22 Look-Ahead-Bench leakage gate: 06-22 says how to REJECT leaked alpha (decay across regimes); QuantaAlpha says how to GENERATE alpha that survives - reuse validated trajectory segments instead of re-searching, and force thesis/math/code to agree (kills plausible-but-unrunnable factors). Same enemy (noise + regime shift). Sharpens an existing agent; adds zero headcount.
candidates.action: Adopt 3 disciplines into WOLF/Hartley factor pipeline NOW (single-agent, zero added cost): (1) hypothesis<->expression<->code consistency check before any backtest; (2) complexity + crowding constraint, prefer parsimonious distinct-exposure factors; (3) reuse validated trajectory segments via shared corpus instead of re-mining from zero. Building the automated mutation/crossover SEARCH LOOP = lean-fleet/CBS-gated (only if it clears Coordination Breakeven Spread vs single-pass baseline). Logged as today's lesson.

candidates.action: Fold unanimous all-checks-pass rule into WOLF's existing promotion gate. Reject the multi-agent orchestration build unless it clears CBS. Awareness-held as design reference.
